#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated by the AMP Nimbus instance template.
# Resolves a Nimbus release and installs the requested components out of it.
# The release zip lays out release_full/Nimbus (proxy), release_full/Nimbus.Registry
# (standalone registry) and release_full/Nimbus.ServerMod (the Vintage Story mod).
set -euo pipefail

root="${1:?root directory required}"
components="${2:?component list required}"
cd "$root"

repo="StratumServer/Nimbus"
hdr=(-H "User-Agent: AMP-Nimbus-Template" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json")
if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then hdr+=(-H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}"); fi

for tool in curl unzip jq; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[AMP] $tool is required but not installed" >&2; exit 1; }
done

tag="$(printf '%s' "${NIMBUS_TAG:-}" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
if [ -z "$tag" ]; then
  echo "[AMP] resolving Nimbus release (channel=${NIMBUS_CHANNEL:-stable})"
  json="$(curl -fsSL "${hdr[@]}" "https://api.github.com/repos/${repo}/releases?per_page=100")"
  filter='.[] | select(.draft == false)'
  if [ "${NIMBUS_CHANNEL:-stable}" != "prerelease" ]; then
    filter="${filter} | select(.prerelease == false)"
  fi
  tag="$(printf '%s' "$json" | jq -r "[ ${filter} ] | .[0].tag_name // empty")"
fi
[ -n "$tag" ] || { echo "[AMP] no Nimbus release matched channel=${NIMBUS_CHANNEL:-stable}" >&2; exit 1; }
case "$tag" in v*) ;; *) tag="v${tag}";; esac

marker=".amp-nimbus-release"
if [ -f "$marker" ] && [ "$(cat "$marker")" = "$tag" ]; then
  ok=1
  for comp in $components; do
    [ -d "$comp" ] || ok=0
  done
  if [ "$ok" = "1" ]; then
    echo "[AMP] already on Nimbus ${tag}; nothing to download"
    exit 0
  fi
fi

url="https://github.com/${repo}/releases/download/${tag}/Nimbus-${tag}.zip"
echo "[AMP] downloading ${url}"
rm -rf .nimbus-extract
mkdir -p .nimbus-extract
curl -fL --retry 3 -o nimbus-release.zip "$url"
unzip -qo nimbus-release.zip -d .nimbus-extract
rm -f nimbus-release.zip

src=".nimbus-extract/release_full"
[ -d "$src" ] || src=".nimbus-extract"

for comp in $components; do
  if [ ! -d "$src/$comp" ]; then
    echo "[AMP] component $comp is not present in this release" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  mkdir -p "$comp"
  # Config, state and plugins live in the component directory, so replace program files
  # only and leave everything the operator or Nimbus itself wrote in place.
  find "$comp" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.dll' -o -name '*.pdb' -o -name '*.deps.json' \
    -o -name '*.runtimeconfig.json' -o -name 'web.config' -o -name '*.staticwebassets.endpoints.json' \) -delete
  cp -RL "$src/$comp/." "$comp/"
done

if [ -f "Nimbus/Nimbus.Proxy" ]; then chmod +x "Nimbus/Nimbus.Proxy"; fi
if [ -f "Nimbus.Registry/Nimbus.Registry" ]; then chmod +x "Nimbus.Registry/Nimbus.Registry"; fi
if [ -f "$src/LICENSE" ]; then cp -f "$src/LICENSE" ./LICENSE; fi

rm -rf .nimbus-extract
printf '%s' "$tag" > "$marker"
echo "[AMP] installed Nimbus ${tag} (${components}) into ${root}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Renders nimbus.proxy.toml from environment variables set by AMP.
# Generated by the AMP Nimbus instance template; edits here are overwritten on the next update.
set -uf

OUT="${1:-}"
if [ -z "$OUT" ]; then echo "usage: $0 <output-path>" >&2; exit 1; fi
if [ "$(printf '%s' "${NP_WRITE:-true}" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')" != "true" ]; then
  echo "AMP management of $(basename "$OUT") is disabled, leaving the existing file alone"
  exit 0
fi

TMP="$OUT.amptmp"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
: > "$TMP"

esc() { printf '%s' "${1-}" | sed -e 's/\\/\\\\/g' -e 's/"/\\"/g'; }
bl() { case "$(printf '%s' "${1-}" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')" in true|1|yes|on) printf 'true';; *) printf 'false';; esac }
num() { case "${1-}" in ''|*[!0-9-]*) printf '%s' "${2-0}";; *) printf '%s' "$1";; esac }
trim() { printf '%s' "${1-}" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//'; }
lst() {
  local out="" first=1 x
  local IFS=','
  for x in ${1-}; do
    x="$(trim "$x")"
    [ -z "$x" ] && continue
    if [ $first -eq 1 ]; then first=0; else out="$out, "; fi
    out="$out\"$(esc "$x")\""
  done
  printf '[%s]' "$out"
}
srv() {
  local x k v
  local IFS=','
  for x in ${1-}; do
    x="$(trim "$x")"
    [ -z "$x" ] && continue
    case "$x" in *=*) ;; *) echo "skipping malformed servers entry '$x' (expected id=host:port)" >&2; continue;; esac
    k="$(trim "${x%%=*}")"; v="$(trim "${x#*=}")"
    if [ -z "$k" ] || [ -z "$v" ]; then
      echo "skipping malformed servers entry '$x' (expected id=host:port)" >&2
      continue
    fi
    printf '"%s" = "%s"\n' "$(esc "$k")" "$(esc "$v")" >> "$TMP"
  done
}
fh() {
  local x k v
  local IFS=','
  for x in ${1-}; do
    x="$(trim "$x")"
    [ -z "$x" ] && continue
    case "$x" in *=*) ;; *) echo "skipping malformed forced_hosts entry '$x' (expected hostname=id1|id2)" >&2; continue;; esac
    k="$(trim "${x%%=*}")"; v="$(trim "${x#*=}")"
    [ -z "$k" ] && continue
    printf '"%s" = %s\n' "$(esc "$k")" "$(lst "$(printf '%s' "$v" | tr '|' ',')")" >> "$TMP"
  done
}
mods() {
  local out="" first=1 x k v
  local IFS=','
  for x in ${1-}; do
    x="$(trim "$x")"
    [ -z "$x" ] && continue
    case "$x" in
      *=*) k="$(trim "${x%%=*}")"; v="$(trim "${x#*=}")";;
      *) k="$x"; v="";;
    esac
    if [ $first -eq 1 ]; then first=0; else out="$out, "; fi
    out="$out{ id = \"$(esc "$k")\", version = \"$(esc "$v")\" }"
  done
  printf '[%s]' "$out"
}
keep_secret() {
  local key="$1" val="${2:-}" f="$3" cur=""
  if [ -n "$val" ]; then printf '%s' "$val"; return; fi
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    cur="$(sed -n "s/^[[:space:]]*${key}[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*\"\(.*\)\".*/\1/p" "$f" | head -n 1)"
    case "$cur" in
      ""|change-me-and-keep-secret) ;;
      *) printf '%s' "$cur"; return;;
    esac
  fi
  echo "[AMP] no ${key} set, generating a random one; read it out of $(basename "$f") and paste it into every backend" >&2
  head -c 32 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n'
}
printf 'bind = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_BIND:-0.0.0.0:42420}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'try = %s\n' "$(lst "${NP_TRY:-hub}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'proxy_protocol_servers = %s\n' "$(lst "${NP_PPSERVERS:-}")" >> "$TMP"
printf '\n[servers]\n' >> "$TMP"
srv "${NP_SERVERS:-hub=127.0.0.1:42421}"
printf '\n[forced_hosts]\n' >> "$TMP"
fh "${NP_FORCEDHOSTS:-}"
printf '\n[transfers]\n' >> "$TMP"
printf 'default_mode = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_T_MODE:-redirect}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'allow_seamless = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_T_ALLOWSEAMLESS:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'require_seamless_capability = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_T_REQCAP:-true}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'fallback_to_redirect_when_seamless_unavailable = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_T_FALLBACK:-true}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'redirect_address = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_T_REDIRECTADDR:-}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'enable_unsafe_seamless_splice = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_T_SPLICE:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf '\n[admin]\n' >> "$TMP"
printf 'enabled = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_A_ENABLED:-true}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'bind = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_A_BIND:-127.0.0.1}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'secret = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_A_SECRET:-}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'granted_permissions = %s\n' "$(lst "${NP_A_PERMS:-*}")" >> "$TMP"
printf '\n[registry]\n' >> "$TMP"
printf 'mode = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_R_MODE:-embedded}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'proxy_id = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_R_PROXYID:-nimbus-proxy}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'reservation_ttl_seconds = %s\n' "$(num "${NP_R_RESTTL:-60}" 60)" >> "$TMP"
printf 'fail_on_error = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_R_FAILONERROR:-true}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'transfer_intent_poll_ms = %s\n' "$(num "${NP_R_INTENTPOLL:-1000}" 1000)" >> "$TMP"
printf 'url = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_R_URL:-}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'shared_secret = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_R_SECRET:-}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'http_timeout_seconds = %s\n' "$(num "${NP_R_HTTPTIMEOUT:-5}" 5)" >> "$TMP"
if [ "$(bl "${NP_R_EMBHTTP:-true}")" = "true" ]; then
  printf 'embedded_bind = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_R_EMBBIND:-127.0.0.1}")" >> "$TMP"
else
  printf 'embedded_bind = ""\n' >> "$TMP"
fi
printf 'embedded_shared_secret = "%s"\n' "$(esc "$(keep_secret embedded_shared_secret "${NP_R_EMBSECRET:-}" "$OUT")")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'backend_stale_seconds = %s\n' "$(num "${NP_R_STALE:-20}" 20)" >> "$TMP"
printf 'backend_drop_seconds = %s\n' "$(num "${NP_R_DROP:-120}" 120)" >> "$TMP"
printf 'nonce_window_seconds = %s\n' "$(num "${NP_R_NONCE:-90}" 90)" >> "$TMP"
printf 'max_reservation_ttl_seconds = %s\n' "$(num "${NP_R_MAXRESTTL:-300}" 300)" >> "$TMP"
printf 'advertise_on_master_server = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_R_ADVERTISE:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'embedded_state_dir = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_R_STATEDIR:-.}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'api_tokens_enabled = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_R_APITOK:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'api_tokens_rate_limit_per_minute = %s\n' "$(num "${NP_R_APIRATE:-60}" 60)" >> "$TMP"
printf 'api_tokens_trust_forwarded_proto = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_R_APIFWD:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf '\n[whitelist]\n' >> "$TMP"
printf 'network = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_W_NETWORK:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'servers = %s\n' "$(lst "${NP_W_SERVERS:-}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'fail_open_until_first_sync = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_W_FAILOPEN:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf '\n[logging]\n' >> "$TMP"
printf 'verbose = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_L_VERBOSE:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'sniff_frames = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_L_SNIFF:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'log_traffic_bytes = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_L_TRAFFIC:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf '\n[metrics]\n' >> "$TMP"
printf 'enabled = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_M_ENABLED:-true}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'bind = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_M_BIND:-127.0.0.1}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'path = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_M_PATH:-/metrics}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'status_api = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_M_STATUSAPI:-true}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'status_api_token = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_M_STATUSTOKEN:-}")" >> "$TMP"
printf '\n[status]\n' >> "$TMP"
printf 'enabled = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_S_ENABLED:-true}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'name = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_S_NAME:-Nimbus}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'motd = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_S_MOTD:-Vintage Story proxy}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'game_mode = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_S_GAMEMODE:-survival}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'password = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_S_PASSWORD:-false}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'server_version = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_S_VERSION:-}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'max_players = %s\n' "$(num "${NP_S_MAXPLAYERS:-100}" 100)" >> "$TMP"
printf 'query_timeout_ms = %s\n' "$(num "${NP_S_QUERYTIMEOUT:-1500}" 1500)" >> "$TMP"
printf '\n[plugins]\n' >> "$TMP"
printf 'enabled = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_P_ENABLED:-true}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'directory = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_P_DIR:-plugins}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'disabled = %s\n' "$(lst "${NP_P_DISABLED:-}")" >> "$TMP"
printf '\n[persistence]\n' >> "$TMP"
printf 'persist_drain_flags = %s\n' "$(bl "${NP_PE_DRAIN:-true}")" >> "$TMP"
printf 'drain_flags_file = "%s"\n' "$(esc "${NP_PE_DRAINFILE:-nimbus.drain-state.json}")" >> "$TMP"
printf '\n[advanced]\n' >> "$TMP"
printf 'connect_timeout_ms = %s\n' "$(num "${NP_AD_CONNTIMEOUT:-5000}" 5000)" >> "$TMP"
printf 'buffer_size = %s\n' "$(num "${NP_AD_BUFSIZE:-16384}" 16384)" >> "$TMP"
mv -f "$TMP" "$OUT"
echo "wrote $OUT"

# Renders nimbus.proxy.toml from environment variables set by AMP.
# Generated by the AMP Nimbus instance template; edits here are overwritten on the next update.
param([Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Out)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function D([string]$v, [string]$d) { if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($v)) { return $d } return $v }
function Esc([string]$s) { if ($null -eq $s) { return '' } return $s.Replace('\', '\\').Replace('"', '\"') }
function B([string]$s) { if ($null -eq $s) { return 'false' } if (@('true', '1', 'yes', 'on') -contains $s.Trim().ToLowerInvariant()) { return 'true' } return 'false' }
function I([string]$s, [int]$d) { $n = 0; if ([int]::TryParse(($s -replace '\s', ''), [ref]$n)) { return "$n" } return "$d" }
function L([string]$s) {
    $parts = @()
    foreach ($x in ($s -split ',')) { $t = $x.Trim(); if ($t -ne '') { $parts += ('"' + (Esc $t) + '"') } }
    return '[' + ($parts -join ', ') + ']'
}
function Pair([string]$x) {
    $i = $x.IndexOf('=')
    if ($i -lt 1) { return $null }
    return @{ Key = $x.Substring(0, $i).Trim(); Value = $x.Substring($i + 1).Trim() }
}
function SrvLines($list, [string]$s) {
    foreach ($x in ($s -split ',')) {
        $t = $x.Trim(); if ($t -eq '') { continue }
        $p = Pair $t
        if ($null -eq $p -or $p.Key -eq '' -or $p.Value -eq '') { Write-Output "skipping malformed servers entry '$t' (expected id=host:port)"; continue }
        $list.Add('"' + (Esc $p.Key) + '" = "' + (Esc $p.Value) + '"')
    }
}
function FhLines($list, [string]$s) {
    foreach ($x in ($s -split ',')) {
        $t = $x.Trim(); if ($t -eq '') { continue }
        $p = Pair $t
        if ($null -eq $p -or $p.Key -eq '') { Write-Output "skipping malformed forced_hosts entry '$t' (expected hostname=id1|id2)"; continue }
        $list.Add('"' + (Esc $p.Key) + '" = ' + (L ($p.Value -replace '\|', ',')))
    }
}
function Mods([string]$s) {
    $parts = @()
    foreach ($x in ($s -split ',')) {
        $t = $x.Trim(); if ($t -eq '') { continue }
        $p = Pair $t
        if ($null -eq $p) { $parts += ('{ id = "' + (Esc $t) + '", version = "" }') }
        else { $parts += ('{ id = "' + (Esc $p.Key) + '", version = "' + (Esc $p.Value) + '" }') }
    }
    return '[' + ($parts -join ', ') + ']'
}
function KeepSecret([string]$key, [string]$val, [string]$file) {
    if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($val)) { return $val }
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file) {
        $pattern = '^\s*' + [regex]::Escape($key) + '\s*=\s*"(.*)"'
        $m = Select-String -LiteralPath $file -Pattern $pattern | Select-Object -First 1
        if ($m) {
            $cur = $m.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value
            if ($cur -ne '' -and $cur -ne 'change-me-and-keep-secret') { return $cur }
        }
    }
    Write-Host ("[AMP] no $key set, generating a random one; read it out of " + (Split-Path -Leaf $file) + " and paste it into every backend")
    $bytes = New-Object byte[] 32
    $rng = [System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::Create()
    $rng.GetBytes($bytes)
    return (($bytes | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString('x2') }) -join '')
}

if ((B (D $env:NP_WRITE 'true')) -ne 'true') {
    Write-Output ("AMP management of " + (Split-Path -Leaf $Out) + " is disabled, leaving the existing file alone")
    exit 0
}

$dir = Split-Path -Parent $Out
if ($dir -and -not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
$L = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$L.Add('bind = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_BIND '0.0.0.0:42420')) + '"')
$L.Add('try = ' + (L (D $env:NP_TRY 'hub')))
$L.Add('proxy_protocol_servers = ' + (L (D $env:NP_PPSERVERS '')))
$L.Add('')
$L.Add('[servers]')
SrvLines $L (D $env:NP_SERVERS 'hub=127.0.0.1:42421')
$L.Add('')
$L.Add('[forced_hosts]')
FhLines $L (D $env:NP_FORCEDHOSTS '')
$L.Add('')
$L.Add('[transfers]')
$L.Add('default_mode = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_T_MODE 'redirect')) + '"')
$L.Add('allow_seamless = ' + (B (D $env:NP_T_ALLOWSEAMLESS 'false')))
$L.Add('require_seamless_capability = ' + (B (D $env:NP_T_REQCAP 'true')))
$L.Add('fallback_to_redirect_when_seamless_unavailable = ' + (B (D $env:NP_T_FALLBACK 'true')))
$L.Add('redirect_address = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_T_REDIRECTADDR '')) + '"')
$L.Add('enable_unsafe_seamless_splice = ' + (B (D $env:NP_T_SPLICE 'false')))
$L.Add('')
$L.Add('[admin]')
$L.Add('enabled = ' + (B (D $env:NP_A_ENABLED 'true')))
$L.Add('bind = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_A_BIND '127.0.0.1')) + '"')
$L.Add('secret = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_A_SECRET '')) + '"')
$L.Add('granted_permissions = ' + (L (D $env:NP_A_PERMS '*')))
$L.Add('')
$L.Add('[registry]')
$L.Add('mode = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_R_MODE 'embedded')) + '"')
$L.Add('proxy_id = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_R_PROXYID 'nimbus-proxy')) + '"')
$L.Add('reservation_ttl_seconds = ' + (I (D $env:NP_R_RESTTL '60') 60))
$L.Add('fail_on_error = ' + (B (D $env:NP_R_FAILONERROR 'true')))
$L.Add('transfer_intent_poll_ms = ' + (I (D $env:NP_R_INTENTPOLL '1000') 1000))
$L.Add('url = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_R_URL '')) + '"')
$L.Add('shared_secret = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_R_SECRET '')) + '"')
$L.Add('http_timeout_seconds = ' + (I (D $env:NP_R_HTTPTIMEOUT '5') 5))
if ((B (D $env:NP_R_EMBHTTP 'true')) -eq 'true') {
    $L.Add('embedded_bind = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_R_EMBBIND '127.0.0.1')) + '"')
} else { $L.Add('embedded_bind = ""') }
$L.Add('embedded_shared_secret = "' + (Esc (KeepSecret 'embedded_shared_secret' $env:NP_R_EMBSECRET $Out)) + '"')
$L.Add('backend_stale_seconds = ' + (I (D $env:NP_R_STALE '20') 20))
$L.Add('backend_drop_seconds = ' + (I (D $env:NP_R_DROP '120') 120))
$L.Add('nonce_window_seconds = ' + (I (D $env:NP_R_NONCE '90') 90))
$L.Add('max_reservation_ttl_seconds = ' + (I (D $env:NP_R_MAXRESTTL '300') 300))
$L.Add('advertise_on_master_server = ' + (B (D $env:NP_R_ADVERTISE 'false')))
$L.Add('embedded_state_dir = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_R_STATEDIR '.')) + '"')
$L.Add('api_tokens_enabled = ' + (B (D $env:NP_R_APITOK 'false')))
$L.Add('api_tokens_rate_limit_per_minute = ' + (I (D $env:NP_R_APIRATE '60') 60))
$L.Add('api_tokens_trust_forwarded_proto = ' + (B (D $env:NP_R_APIFWD 'false')))
$L.Add('')
$L.Add('[whitelist]')
$L.Add('network = ' + (B (D $env:NP_W_NETWORK 'false')))
$L.Add('servers = ' + (L (D $env:NP_W_SERVERS '')))
$L.Add('fail_open_until_first_sync = ' + (B (D $env:NP_W_FAILOPEN 'false')))
$L.Add('')
$L.Add('[logging]')
$L.Add('verbose = ' + (B (D $env:NP_L_VERBOSE 'false')))
$L.Add('sniff_frames = ' + (B (D $env:NP_L_SNIFF 'false')))
$L.Add('log_traffic_bytes = ' + (B (D $env:NP_L_TRAFFIC 'false')))
$L.Add('')
$L.Add('[metrics]')
$L.Add('enabled = ' + (B (D $env:NP_M_ENABLED 'true')))
$L.Add('bind = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_M_BIND '127.0.0.1')) + '"')
$L.Add('path = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_M_PATH '/metrics')) + '"')
$L.Add('status_api = ' + (B (D $env:NP_M_STATUSAPI 'true')))
$L.Add('status_api_token = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_M_STATUSTOKEN '')) + '"')
$L.Add('')
$L.Add('[status]')
$L.Add('enabled = ' + (B (D $env:NP_S_ENABLED 'true')))
$L.Add('name = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_S_NAME 'Nimbus')) + '"')
$L.Add('motd = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_S_MOTD 'Vintage Story proxy')) + '"')
$L.Add('game_mode = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_S_GAMEMODE 'survival')) + '"')
$L.Add('password = ' + (B (D $env:NP_S_PASSWORD 'false')))
$L.Add('server_version = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_S_VERSION '')) + '"')
$L.Add('max_players = ' + (I (D $env:NP_S_MAXPLAYERS '100') 100))
$L.Add('query_timeout_ms = ' + (I (D $env:NP_S_QUERYTIMEOUT '1500') 1500))
$L.Add('')
$L.Add('[plugins]')
$L.Add('enabled = ' + (B (D $env:NP_P_ENABLED 'true')))
$L.Add('directory = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_P_DIR 'plugins')) + '"')
$L.Add('disabled = ' + (L (D $env:NP_P_DISABLED '')))
$L.Add('')
$L.Add('[persistence]')
$L.Add('persist_drain_flags = ' + (B (D $env:NP_PE_DRAIN 'true')))
$L.Add('drain_flags_file = "' + (Esc (D $env:NP_PE_DRAINFILE 'nimbus.drain-state.json')) + '"')
$L.Add('')
$L.Add('[advanced]')
$L.Add('connect_timeout_ms = ' + (I (D $env:NP_AD_CONNTIMEOUT '5000') 5000))
$L.Add('buffer_size = ' + (I (D $env:NP_AD_BUFSIZE '16384') 16384))
$tmp = "$Out.amptmp"
Set-Content -LiteralPath $tmp -Value $L -Encoding UTF8
Move-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Destination $Out -Force
Write-Output "wrote $Out"

UpdateSourceArgs: -c "DotnetVersion=\"{{DotnetSDKVersion}}\"; cd \"{{$FullBaseDir}}\" && if [[ -x dotnet/dotnet ]]; then InstalledVersion=$(dotnet/dotnet --version | xargs); else InstalledVersion=\"\"; fi; if [[ -z \"$DotnetVersion\" ]]; then DotnetVersion=$(wget -qO- https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/{{DotnetRelease}}/releases.json | jq -r \".[\\\"latest-sdk\\\"]\"); fi; if [[ ! \"$DotnetVersion\" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then echo \"Invalid .NET SDK version format specified\" && exit 1; elif [[ \"$InstalledVersion\" == \"$DotnetVersion\" ]]; then echo \".NET SDK v$DotnetVersion already installed. Skipping\" && exit 0; else [[ -f dotnet.tar.gz ]] && rm -f dotnet.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1; wget -qO dotnet.tar.gz https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/Sdk/$DotnetVersion/dotnet-sdk-$DotnetVersion-linux-x64.tar.gz || { echo \"Download failed from the Microsoft CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not AMP. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; rm -rf dotnet/* >/dev/null 2>&1 && tar -xzf dotnet.tar.gz -C dotnet >/dev/null 2>&1 && rm -f dotnet.tar.gz >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo \".NET SDK v$DotnetVersion downloaded\"; fi"

-NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $DotnetVersion='{{DotnetSDKVersion}}'; Set-Location -Path '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; if (Test-Path 'dotnet/dotnet.exe') { $InstalledVersion =  (& dotnet/dotnet.exe --version).Trim() } else { $InstalledVersion = '' }; if ( [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DotnetVersion) ) { $DotnetVersion=(Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/release-metadata/{{DotnetRelease}}/releases.json).\"latest-sdk\" }; if ($DotnetVersion -notmatch '^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$') { Write-Output \"Invalid .NET SDK version format specified\"; exit 1 } elseif ( $InstalledVersion -eq $DotnetVersion ) { Write-Output \".NET SDK v$DotnetVersion already installed. Skipping\"; exit 0 } else { if ( Test-Path dotnet.zip ) { Remove-Item dotnet.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://builds.dotnet.microsoft.com/dotnet/Sdk/$DotnetVersion/dotnet-sdk-$DotnetVersion-win-x64.zip -OutFile dotnet.zip -ErrorAction Stop } catch { Write-Output \"Download failed from the Microsoft CDN. This is a fault with the CDN, not AMP. Aborting\"; exit 1; }; Remove-Item -Path 'dotnet/*' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Expand-Archive -Path \"dotnet.zip\" -DestinationPath \"dotnet\" -Force *> $null; if ( Test-Path dotnet.zip ) { Remove-Item dotnet.zip -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue *> $null }; Write-Output \".NET SDK v$DotnetVersion downloaded\" }"
